text: つよそうだね　ぜひ　おてあわせを！

structure.jp: ぜひ　おてあわせを！

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そうだ on a describing word with its last い dropped means 'looks'. つよそうだ = 'you look strong'.

patterns.name: 〜を (verb left out)
patterns.explanation: The sentence stops at を and leaves the verb unsaid, a polite way to ask; 'please grant me' is understood. おてあわせを = 'a match, please'.
